question: A ray of light passes from medium A into medium B. It is observed that the ray bends towards the normal in medium B. What can be fundamentally concluded about the speed of light in these two media?

options.A: The speed of light is the same in both media.
options.B: The speed of light is greater in medium B than in medium A.
options.C: The speed of light is lower in medium B than in medium A.
options.D: The speed of light depends on the frequency, which changes in medium B.
